name: Look at the Size of It!
summary: In the Searing Gorge, you have a gigantic, ornate pillow once kept by Chambermaid Pillaclencher. Evonice Sootsmoker is sure to want it.

sections.title: A Pillow for Evonice
sections.body: Evonice Sootsmoker is sure to want Chambermaid Pillaclencher's gigantic, ornate pillow. Bring it to her in the Searing Gorge and see what she offers for your trouble.

aliases: who do i bring the pillow to
faq.answer: Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge is sure to want Chambermaid Pillaclencher's pillow.

faq.q: Where does this pillow come from?
faq.answer: The gigantic, ornate pillow once belonged to Chambermaid Pillaclencher.

faq.q: Where can Evonice Sootsmoker be found?
faq.answer: Evonice Sootsmoker is in the Searing Gorge.
